name: jlv-workspace
description: Private pnpm workspace root of jlv 2. The published package lives in packages/jlv.

scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('packages/jlv/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p packages/jlv/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:build: node -e "fs.rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test-dist/scripts/prepare-test-tree.js
scripts.test: pnpm run test:build && pnpm run test:run
